segments.description: Showcasing the completed cooked masala pasta dish plated nicely.
Channel intro animation displaying the logo and name Shyam Rasoi.
Showing the package of Disano Penne Pasta, explaining its benefits, opening it, and pouring pasta into a bowl.
Boiling the penne pasta in water with salt and oil, checking for doneness, and straining it.
Preparing the pasta sauce by sauteing garlic, onions, tomatoes, spices, vegetables, sauces, mayonnaise, and tossing the cooked pasta.
Plating the delicious masala pasta and displaying the final garnished dish.

hook.opening_visual: Close-up shot of cooked masala pasta being stirred in a pan.
hook.opening_line: आज हम बनाएंगे बहुत ही स्पेशल एकदम टेस्टी और लाजवाब सा मसाला पास्ता
hook.notes: The video starts with a appetizing preview of the finished pasta recipe being stirred and plated.

cta_moments.text: Mentioning link in description box to buy Disano penne pasta.
Asking viewers to comment on how they liked the recipe.
Asking viewers to like and share the video.
